preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**12 for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: Each test case K is between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(K, int) and K >= 0 for K in output)
postconditions.description: Each output K is a non-negative integer.
Each output K is a magical number.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == find_kth_magical(Ks[i], i) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output K is the K-th magical number for the corresponding input K.
